name: Azaps
headerMeta: Heroic era · Melee Infantry · shields · 225 leadership · Seasonal (Blood of the Empire S3) & Honor Tree

origin.text: Seasonal Unit & Honor Tree - Blood of the Empire Season 3 & Heroic Era
unlock: Normal unit-challenge tree: 3-day contract -> experience boost -> permanent unlock
Unlock doctrine reduces 'on watch' (counter-stance) cooldown by ~4s

pitch: A mobile shielded melee that trades some defense for speed, excelling as a flanker and duelist against isolated targets. It struggles hard against high-defense units, block-equipped troops, and ranged pressure — never lead with it into pikes or high-armor walls.

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: Culminates in a chance to auto-initiate Counter Strike when attacked. {2} Early nodes grant bonus health, +2% all-defenses, +3% health, −3s cooldown; further upgrades add −5% damage taken during Counter Strike, reduced counter-attack damage taken, knockdown immunity, +1s Counter Strike duration. {2}

battleRole.positioning: Mobile flanker — send it around to catch isolated units or soak up burst before your main line engages. {1} Pair with a tankier unit in early game to soak initial contact. {2}
battleRole.tips: Slashing-focused: slashing penetration/damage doctrines vastly outperform blunt. {2} Squishy without veterancy — full top tree is essential for survival at T4/T5 tier. {2} Iron Reapers is a tough matchup at high investment; comfortable 1v1 against Spear Sergeants / Imperial Spears once Counter Strike upgrades are complete. {2}

numbers.label: Base HP without veterancy
numbers.value: ~6,500, 2020 creator recall - unverified, likely predates the 2025 rework

cards.name: Block-equipped troops (Imperial Spears, Spear Sergeants)
cards.why: CCi + armor; Azaps counters shield-walls but struggles if outnumbered or caught mid-charge

cards.name: Phalanx / ranged-heavy
cards.why: range and sustained pressure deny flank engagement

cards.name: Burst units, good flanking units
cards.why: Azaps excels at isolating and finishing weak/wounded targets

controls.notes: X-move in → press 2 (damage ability) and Ironside together when the first line will take damage. {1} Let skill 2 run out (auto-executes second phase). {1} When ~5s remain on the follow-up cooldown, press 3 (likely a finisher or repositioning ability). {1} Counter Strike auto-triggers on attack if top veterancy is complete; use knockdown immunity window to reposition if surrounded. {2}
